title: Edatlar (Prepositions)
description_tr: Ingilizce'de zaman, yer ve yon bildiren edatlar (in, on, at, to, from, by vb.) ile sifat+edat ve fiil+edat kombinasyonlarini kapsar. Turkce'de eklere karsilik gelir (-de, -da, -e, -den gibi) ama birebir ceviri yapilmaz. Mantigi kavramak onemli: 'in' kapali/genis alan, 'on' yuzey/temas, 'at' nokta/konum.
formula: in + ay/yil/mevsim/ulke/sehir | on + gun/tarih/yuzey | at + saat/nokta/adres | to + yon/hedef | from + kaynak/baslangic
turkish_logic: Turkce'de 'hastanede' dediginde hep '-de' eki kullanirsin. Ingilizce'de ise 'at the hospital' (orada bulunma), 'in the hospital' (binanin icinde), 'to the hospital' (oraya dogru) diye degisir. Her edat farkli bir iliskiyi anlatir.
key_rules: ZAMAN — in: aylar (in March), yillar (in 2024), mevsimler (in summer), gunun bolumleri (in the morning/afternoon/evening). ISTISNA: at night
ZAMAN — on: gunler (on Monday), tarihler (on 15th March), ozel gunler (on my birthday, on Christmas Day)
ZAMAN — at: saatler (at 9 AM), belirli anlar (at noon, at midnight, at the moment, at the weekend — BE)
YER — in: ulkeler (in Turkey), sehirler (in Istanbul), kapali alanlar (in the operating room), genis alanlar (in the park)
YER — on: yuzeyler (on the table), katlar (on the third floor), yollar (on Istiklal Street), tasitlar (on the bus/train/plane — icinde olup hareket eden)
YER — at: noktalar (at the bus stop), adresler (at 42 Oak Street), binalar-islevsel (at school, at the hospital, at home)
SIFAT + EDAT: afraid of, allergic to, aware of, capable of, familiar with, good/bad at, interested in, responsible for, similar to, tired of
FIIL + EDAT: agree with, apologize for, apply for, believe in, belong to, consist of, depend on, look after, recover from, suffer from, wait for

examples.en: The surgery is scheduled on Monday at 9 AM in the main operating room.
examples.tr: Ameliyat Pazartesi saat 9'da ana ameliyathanede planlanmistir.
examples.why: Gun → on Monday. Saat → at 9 AM. Kapali alan → in the operating room.

examples.en: The patient has been suffering from chronic pain since 2019.
examples.why: 'suffer from' sabit fiil+edat kombinasyonu. 'since 2019' belirli baslangic noktasi.

examples.en: She is allergic to penicillin and afraid of needles.
examples.tr: Penisiline alerjisi var ve ignelerden korkuyor.
examples.why: 'allergic to' ve 'afraid of' sabit sifat+edat kaliplari. Turkce'de '-e' ve '-den' eki — ama Ingilizce'de ezberlenmeli.

examples.en: The nurse looked after the patient in the ICU on the second floor.
examples.tr: Hemsire ikinci kattaki yogun bakimdaki hastaya bakti.
examples.why: 'look after' = ilgilenmek (phrasal verb). 'in the ICU' kapali alan. 'on the second floor' kat bildiriyor.

examples.en: Dr. Aydin arrived at the hospital in the morning and went to the lab.
examples.tr: Dr. Aydin sabah hastaneye vardi ve laboratuvara gitti.
examples.why: 'at the hospital' varış noktası. 'in the morning' gunun bolumu. 'to the lab' yon/hedef.

examples.en: The treatment depends on the results of the blood test.
examples.why: 'depend on' sabit fiil+edat. Turkce'de '-e bagli' ama Ingilizce'de 'on' kullanilir.

tips: IN/ON/AT ZAMANDA BUYUKTEN KUCUGE: in (yil, ay, mevsim = genis) → on (gun, tarih = orta) → at (saat, an = nokta). Buyukten kucuge in-on-at.
ARRIVE KURALI: arrive at + nokta (arrive at the hospital), arrive in + sehir/ulke (arrive in Istanbul). ASLA 'arrive to' OLMAZ!
TRANSPORT EDATLARI: by + tasit (genel) → by bus, by car. Ama in a car (belirli araba), on the bus/train/plane (icinde oldugun tasit). 'on foot' = yuruyerek.
SIFAT+EDAT EZBERLE: Sinavda en az 2-3 soru gelir. 'interested in', 'good at', 'afraid of', 'responsible for', 'similar to' — bunlari flashcard yap.
IN HOSPITAL vs AT THE HOSPITAL: 'in hospital' = hasta olarak yatiyor (BE). 'at the hospital' = orada bulunuyor (ziyaretci, calisan vb.). Bu fark sinavda cikar.
